value.title: Transient scheduling preserves registration refusals

sections.name: body
sections.value: Round-two security review of #281 at b803bdb332196fb43bdf78a7c9fcc263c70ef1b1: RegistrationError::is_transient is a scheduling classifier, not an admission override. Its exhaustive match keeps Refused, InvalidSeatId, Retired, PaneHeld and PaneHolderChild false (crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:63-76), and CodexBinder retains those as decisions/Seen (crates/daemon/src/codex_bind.rs:375-386). Runtime and Retryable retry the complete probe and registration with existing process-start, locked roster, owner-close and concurrent-close guards. Ordinary Codex binding passes no native transport or precedence (codex_bind.rs:344-372); NativeSessionHold and NativeHolderCurrent arise only on native branches (registration.rs:750-781,1246-1259,1350-1359), so marking these transient does not fight plan168 or make its brake reachable from Codex. The thread-start failure-map reset changes scheduling, not authority; do not claim row-local cost isolation from that security proof. Baseline #279 carry remains outside this PR delta. Security-agent tests/builds/probes were not run; exact-head CI passed 2634 tests, six skipped. Existing difficulty and magicWand remain Dependency-free review readiness gap: a scoped exact-head review mode should separate CI-backed proof and unavailable local dependencies, without repairing shared tooling.
